Research Manager

Accelerate and guide AI safety researchers, facilitating high-impact projects. Work with mentors and scholars to provide feedback, drive projects to completion, and support career development. May specialize in theory, engineering, management, or communication. Requires 2-5 years experience in project management, research management, people management, technical research, governance, or mentoring. Please apply by Oct 20 to be considered for a January 2027 start date. We are open to an earlier start date on a case by case basis. We will hold rolling hiring for future cohorts.

(Senior) Program Manager, Mentor Selection

Own MATS's mentor selection end to end — headhunting mentors, gathering evaluations from our selection committee and advisors, and proposing how we allocate fellows across mentors and research agendas, three to four cycles a year. It's closest in spirit to grantmaking: the job runs on real taste about AI safety research and the people doing it, and the judgment to turn many messy inputs into a decision you can defend.
